notes: Use a Suica card on every train; Google Maps is flawless for train times. A JR Pass is unnecessary within Tokyo; get a Tobu pass for Nikko.
November brings momiji, December illuminations and late March sakura. Winter is 5-10°C, dry, with clear Fuji views.
Cash still matters (small ramen shops); 7-Eleven ATMs accept foreign cards. No tipping.
Stay quiet in temples; photography is banned inside. Don't talk on the phone on the metro or eat while walking.
Book Shibuya Sky and teamLab tickets weeks ahead; reach Tsukiji before 10:00.
Ramen costs 1,000-1,500 JPY, a konbini breakfast 500 JPY and a sushi counter 3,000+.

transit.name: Suica / Welcome Suica
transit.why_chosen: Works on JR, metro, buses and at konbini; can also be added to your phone
transit.coverage: Tokyo'daki tüm tren ve metro hatları, otobüsler, marketler
transit.where_to_buy: Havalimanı ve JR istasyonları; iPhone Wallet

stops.name: Senso-ji
stops.tips: Tokyo's oldest temple. See the Kaminarimon lantern, catch Nakamise empty at 08:00 and draw an omikuji fortune.

stops.name: Nakamise Dori
stops.tips: Shops along the temple approach. Try ningyo-yaki (small sponge cakes) and senbei (rice crackers).

stops.name: Asakusa Kappabashi
stops.tips: Kitchenware street. Look for Japanese knives and plastic food models.

stops.name: Asakusa Unatoto
stops.tips: Cheap unagi (eel) donburi, with a short queue.

stops.name: Tokyo Skytree
stops.tips: 634 m tall. Book Tembo Deck tickets online, go in the afternoon for clear skies and walk over the Sumida River.

backups.name: Asakusa Imahan
backups.tips: Sukiyaki since 1895. Go for a special lunch.

backups.name: Sumida River Boat Tour
backups.tips: Water bus from Asakusa to Odaiba. An alternative to Skytree.

stops.name: Meiji Jingu
stops.tips: Shinto shrine in the forest. See the sake barrels; it's quiet in the morning, with wedding processions at weekends.

stops.name: Takeshita Street
stops.tips: Harajuku youth fashion and crepe stalls. It gets packed after 11:00.

stops.name: Omotesando
stops.tips: Tokyo's Champs-Élysées. Come for the architecture and the mirrored entrance of Tokyu Plaza.

stops.name: Afuri Ramen Harajuku
stops.tips: Yuzu shio ramen. Order from the ticket machine.

stops.name: Shibuya Sky
stops.tips: Open-air rooftop above the Shibuya Scramble. Book the sunset slot online weeks ahead and watch the crossing from above.

backups.name: Ichiran Shibuya
backups.tips: Tonkotsu ramen in single-person booths. Open 24 hours.

backups.name: Yoyogi Park
backups.tips: Park next to Meiji Jingu. Rockabilly dancers perform at weekends.

stops.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
stops.tips: Morning stalls serve tamago (sweet omelette), uni (sea urchin) and tuna. Arrive before 10:00 and eat standing up.

stops.name: Hamarikyu Gardens
stops.tips: Edo-period garden among skyscrapers. Have matcha at the tea house.

stops.name: Ginza Chuo Dori
stops.tips: Closed to traffic at weekends. Visit the Itoya stationery store and the 12-floor Uniqlo.

stops.name: Ginza Kagari Ramen
stops.tips: Chicken paitan ramen. Small counter, expect a queue.

stops.name: teamLab Planets
stops.tips: Digital art museum where you wade through water. Book online weeks ahead and wear shorts (the water is knee-deep).

backups.name: Sushi Dai Toyosu
backups.tips: Legendary sushi at Toyosu Market. The queue starts at 05:00.

backups.name: Ginza Six Rooftop Garden
backups.tips: Shopping centre rooftop. Good if you have no teamLab ticket.

stops.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building
stops.tips: Free observation deck on the 45th floor. Mount Fuji is visible on clear days.

stops.name: Shinjuku Gyoen
stops.tips: Japanese, English and French gardens. Loveliest in sakura and momiji (autumn leaves) season.

stops.name: Fuunji Shinjuku
stops.tips: Tsukemen (dipping ramen) legend. Expect a 20-minute queue.

stops.name: Yanaka Ginza
stops.tips: Old Tokyo (shitamachi) shopping street. Look for cats, menchi katsu (fried minced meat cutlet) and Yanaka Cemetery.

stops.name: Omoide Yokocho
stops.tips: Izakaya alley in Shinjuku. Yakitori and beer in 'Piss Alley'.

backups.name: Golden Gai
backups.tips: Neighbourhood of tiny bars. Ask about the cover charge.

backups.name: Nezu Shrine
backups.tips: Red torii tunnel near Yanaka. Azaleas bloom in April.

stops.name: Ueno Park
stops.tips: Park of museums. The heart of Tokyo in sakura season.

stops.name: Tokyo National Museum
stops.tips: Japan's largest museum, with samurai armour and ukiyo-e (woodblock prints).

stops.name: Ameyoko Market
stops.tips: Market beneath the Ueno tracks. Street food and dried fruit.

stops.name: Akihabara Electric Town
stops.tips: Electronics, anime and retro games. Try Yodobashi and Super Potato.

stops.name: Odaiba Seaside Park
stops.tips: Artificial island reached by the Yurikamome line. See Rainbow Bridge at sunset and the giant Gundam.

backups.name: Ueno Zoo
backups.tips: Pandas. An alternative to the museum.

stops.name: Nikko Toshogu Shrine
stops.tips: 2 hours from Tokyo (Tobu line). Tokugawa's gilded mausoleum and the three wise monkeys, loveliest under snow.

stops.name: Rinnoji Temple
stops.tips: Three golden Buddhas, next to Toshogu.

stops.name: Nikko Yuba Restaurant
stops.tips: Yuba (tofu skin) meal, a Nikko speciality.

stops.name: Kegon Falls
stops.tips: 97 m waterfall. Take the lift to the bottom; it freezes in winter.

stops.name: Lake Chuzenji
stops.tips: Mountain lake and onsen, on the way back from Nikko.

days.theme: Tokyo Station and Imperial Palace: gentle farewell

stops.name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
stops.tips: Gardens of the former Edo castle. Free; closed on Mondays and Fridays.

stops.name: Tokyo Station Marunouchi
stops.tips: Red-brick station from 1914. Visit Character Street and pick up an ekiben (station bento).

stops.name: Rokurinsha Tokyo Station
stops.tips: Tsukemen on Ramen Street. A farewell lunch.

stops.name: Tokyo Character Street
stops.tips: Souvenirs: Kit Kat flavours and Tokyo Banana.

stops.name: Narita Express / Keisei
stops.tips: 1 hour to Narita, 30 minutes to Haneda. Farewell.

backups.name: Nihonbashi Bridge
backups.tips: Japan's kilometre zero. Coredo shopping centre nearby.
